title: Tenant location capability profile
description: What a tenant's network can really do, and what this platform has built for it. The location API consults this before promising an accuracy. Every claim here must be traceable to a test or an operator statement; a request that asks for more than this profile allows is answered with the best available position and accuracyFulfilled=false, never an error that hides what was possible.

version.description: Profile revision. Bumped whenever a claim changes.

ati_allowed.description: Whether MAP Any Time Interrogation may be sent for this tenant. SS7-abuse sensitive: only with an authorised client request behind it.

psi_allowed.description: Whether MAP Provide Subscriber Info may be sent. Pages the subscriber, so it is rate limited.

active_location_paging.description: Whether the platform may page an idle subscriber to obtain a fresh location.

emergency_override.description: Whether the emergency path is enabled. Every use is audited separately.

max_accuracy_granted_m.description: Coarsest accuracy this tenant is allowed to publish to clients, in metres. A coarser result is reported as such.

plmns.description: PLMNs whose subscribers this tenant may locate. Other prefixes are rejected at validation.

serving_node.description: The core node that answers a location request for this RAT.

engine.description: The positioning engine used, or null when the RAT is cell-ID only (D9).

methods.description: Methods this RAT is designed to support.

method_status.description: Build state per method. Required so no profile can imply a method that does not exist yet.

lpp.description: LPP supported between UE and the positioning engine.

lppa.description: LPPa supported between eNB and the E-SMLC. Operator-dependent.

nrppa.description: NRPPa supported between gNB and the LMF. Operator-dependent.

prs_configured.description: Positioning reference signals actually transmitted on the RAN.

trp_count.description: Transmission/reception points known to the engine. Zero means geometry-based methods are impossible.

allOf.$comment: A non-null engine must report at least CELL_ID.
Geometry-based methods require more than one TRP.
